title: Do not add or ask for metrics on Adsmovil, Hogarth or freelance achievements: metrics are closed with only the two RPPL ones
body: Closed by the author 2026-10-29. Only `dinkum-mapbox` (~13.000 districts, estimated; live count 13.360) and `dinkum-mapbox-index` (index time 5 s -> 500 ms, estimated) carry a `metric`. The `before` of 5 s is the worst case of the real 3-5 s range, chosen by the author 2026-10-28. The author has no access to the Adsmovil, Hogarth or freelance systems and does not remember their figures, so `adsmovil-audiencias`, `adsmovil-campanias`, `adsmovil-mapbox`, `hogarth-i18n` and `freelance-landings` stay WITHOUT a metric: not a reconstructed one, not a placeholder, and do not prompt the author for one again. Reopen only if a real source appears (an old report, a colleague, a public page) and record it in `metric.source`. Any new estimate gets `confidence: "estimated"` so formatMetric renders "~".
not_derivable: Missing metrics look like a data gap to fill; nothing in the repo says the author already exhausted every source and closed the question.

evidence.summary: Only dinkum-mapbox and dinkum-mapbox-index have a metric, each with confidence estimated and a source note.
Author 2026-10-29: no access to older roles' systems or figures; metrics closed; reopen only with a source.
